raw_segments.text: No sooner he, with them of man and beast select for life, shall in the ark be lodged and sheltered round.
But all the cataracts of heaven set open on the earth shall pour rain day and night.
All fountains of the deep broke up shall heave the ocean to usurp beyond all bounds till inundation rise above the highest hills.
Then shall this mount of paradise by might of waves be moved out of his place,
pushed by the horned flood, with all his verger spoiled, and trees adrift down the great river to the opening gulf,
and there take root an island salt and bare, the haunt of seals and orcs and sea-mues clang.
